description: Source code for handling remote repositories within Git, including remote validation, URL aliasing, remote creation, configuration parsing, ref management, and push operations.

classes.name: struct remote
classes.description: Represents a remote repository, including its URL list, push/pull refspecs, authentication options, and configuration flags.

classes.name: struct branch
classes.description: Represents a branch with associated merge configurations, remote information, and tracking pointers.

classes.name: struct refspec_item
classes.description: Represents individual refspec rules for ref matching and pushing.

classes.name: struct ref
classes.description: Represents a Git reference, such as a branch or tag, with associated OIDs and tracking info.

classes.name: struct refspec
classes.description: A set of refspec rules for pushing or fetching refs.

classes.name: struct remote_state
classes.description: Maintains the state of remotes within a repository, including hash tables and remotes array.

classes.name: struct stale_heads_info
classes.description: Data structure used for identifying stale remote refs that are no longer matched by refspecs.
